detail.longDescription:
> The CSS Working Group [https://www.w3.org/groups/wg/css] has published a First
Public Working Draft of Animation Triggers. It defines CSS properties and an API
for creating mechanisms that affect animation playback, based on DOM events
resulting from user interaction, or on entry/exit of ranges on animation
timelines. In simple terms: this will let you start animations based on defined
triggers, like mouse clicks or certain scroll (progress) events.
